risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the cylinder head and block for cracks or wear.

risks.risk: Engine may be from a non-Korean vehicle or not genuine Korean parts
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head with visible brand/model markings, or a photo of the VIN tag or original vehicle plate.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing any brand or model markings.
Video or photo of the engine running or being tested.
Photo of the oil pan and cylinder head for signs of leaks or damage.
